basis: Static inspection of installed bun-pty 0.4.8 src/terminal.ts and prior isolated TUI observations.

forcedTermination.source: Terminal.kill emits a synthetic zero with the requested signal after native kill/close.

observedExit.interpretation: Unresolved: the PTY status alone does not establish an application crash or successful exit.

policy: Do not promote parent driver success, a synthetic PTY zero, or an unresolved negative PTY code into successful application completion.
